topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: It seems the plot has unravelled, or so they say. What was meant to be a stealthy assembly of well-wishers lies in the ruins of unkept promises. Curious, the way plans that seemed so sturdy crumble at the seam, leaving more than just a gap in the calendar. Perhaps, in this unexpected void, there's room now to breathe, to ponder what truly fills the heart. Was the thrill in the surprise, or in the sharing, the company, the laughter that was to follow? I imagine, in this silence, there's a different kind of celebration waiting, one that doesn’t fade with the passing of the moment. A gathering of thoughts, of memories, unscripted and all the more profound.
